title: Eight Sleep hero
description: A tall, airy product hero on a pale-blue sky: a tiny mono 'NEW' label, an enormous soft-gradient product name, the product floating over it, then a two-line lede, a bold price line, a white button and a condensed 4.6-star rating. On load a dark veil lifts off the sky and the title fades up; while you scroll (desktop) the words drift up 224px and the product 400px, so they part like layers.
notes: dark-scoped: white text over a sky; the empty sky slot is a glow-to-pale gradient from the theme
the product slot is 795×1023 (418×538 on phones), drawn as a soft glow when empty because the original's video is contain-fitted
sits behind a fixed header: it starts with ~120px of top room
CSS only: load-in keyframes and scroll(root) parallax; reduced motion shows everything still
